Title: Architecture review gate C
Purpose: Stop after the remaining correctness, query-cohesion, and helper-isolation work to verify that the Process module is actually ready for final performance and closure proof.
Deliverables: A written Gate C memo with explicit pass/fail decision.
An explicit statement on whether the remaining closure work is now performance/cleanup only instead of correctness repair.
A corrective subbundle if any correctness or thread-safety gap still survives into this gate.
ValidationCommands: Review the live repository and fresh proof for subbundles 07-09.
ReviewQuestions: Do all editor paths now provide the metadata needed for stale-write detection?
Is the workspace read path cohesive enough that one refresh does not tear across many unrelated calls without intention?
Are template helpers isolated enough, and is the pack-thread-safety/caching decision explicit and safe?
CorrectiveOnFailure: If any answer is no, stop and create the matching corrective subbundle before proceeding to final scaling/closure work.
